items.title: Sodrive
items.content: Sodrive centers the driving-school website around the next practical step: requesting a trial lesson. The experience combines lesson and pricing information, intensive courses, theory content, customer reviews, service-area information and a direct trial-lesson form.
items.excerpt: Sodrive centres its driving-school site on trial lessons, pricing, course information, reviews and regional coverage.

items.title: Autoinkoopatlas
items.content: Auto Inkoop Atlas turns vehicle selling into a form-first WordPress journey. Sellers can start with a registration number or vehicle details, add contact information and an optional photo, then understand the three-step process from vehicle submission to offer and sale across different vehicle conditions and types.
items.excerpt: Automotive lead-generation WordPress website with progressive vehicle submission, service segmentation and a clear three-step vehicle-selling process.

items.title: Boekhoudsnel
items.content: Boekhoudsnel translates a bookkeeping service into a focused proposition built around service clarity, trust and direct enquiry. Visitors can understand the financial-support offer without having to work through dense or overly technical accounting content.
items.excerpt: Boekhoudsnel explains bookkeeping support, trust information and a direct path to an initial service enquiry.

items.title: Voltworks
items.content: Voltworks gives solar panels, charging stations, home batteries and heat pumps separate service paths within the same site. Company information and reviews support those choices, while quote and support actions stay attached to the relevant solution.
items.excerpt: Sustainable-energy site with separate paths for solar, charging, batteries and heat pumps, backed by reviews and quote actions.

items.title: Jouwgroenteboer
items.content: Fresh-produce shopping defines the Jouwgroenteboer WooCommerce webshop, combining fruit and vegetable categories, individual products, delivery information and cart-oriented actions. The webshop keeps catalogue browsing, product choice and ordering connected from larger screens down to mobile.
items.excerpt: WooCommerce grocery webshop combining fresh-produce categories, product-led browsing, delivery information and cart-oriented shopping routes.

items.title: Kervana
items.content: Kervana presents plumbing and climate-technology services through a service-oriented WordPress site. Air conditioning, underfloor heating, heat pumps, maintenance and boilers are separated into clear routes, supported by recent projects, customer reviews and a direct quotation path.
items.excerpt: Installation-services site covering air conditioning, underfloor heating, heat pumps, maintenance and boilers, supported by project proof, reviews and quote access.

items.title: Envolt
items.content: The required electrical service determines Envolt's entry point, followed by concise technical context rather than a dense catalogue. Responsive pages keep quote and contact actions visible beside the relevant service.
items.excerpt: Envolt connects electrical-service orientation with concise technical context and direct quotation access.

items.title: Ozturkmotionpictures
items.content: Ozturk Motion Pictures lets wedding films, photography and real-couple stories carry the visual portfolio. Galleries and storytelling material keep the imagery central, with contact access available once visitors have reviewed the work.
items.excerpt: Wedding photography and film WordPress portfolio combining visual storytelling, galleries, couple stories and a clear enquiry path.

items.title: Odetra
items.content: Odetra frames international real-estate investment and project development through project and market information first. Company positioning and contact access then support visitors evaluating opportunities across multiple regions.
items.excerpt: Odetra connects international real-estate projects and market context with a direct contact route for prospective clients.

items.title: Marcoverhuurt
items.content: The rental offer leads Marco Verhuurt, followed immediately by the question of availability. Supporting information stays close to the relevant option, with enquiry access preserved on both larger and smaller screens.
items.excerpt: Rental-services site keeping the offer, supporting information and availability enquiries in one short selection path.

items.title: Devrijesmid
items.content: De Vrije Smid gives plumbing and sanitary-installation work a concise customer-facing structure. Service descriptions make the type of technical support clear before visitors move to contact.
items.excerpt: Plumbing and installation site turning technical services into concise customer-facing information followed by enquiry.

items.title: Palmeroshop
items.content: Palmero Shop organizes massage guns and recovery accessories into a product-led WordPress ecommerce experience. Product education, supporting articles, FAQs, delivery and return information, and the shopping journey are connected so customers can understand the products before moving into checkout.
items.excerpt: WordPress ecommerce site for massage and recovery products combining product browsing, education, FAQs, store policies and shopping routes.

items.title: Woningontruimingvergelijken
items.content: Woningontruimingvergelijken structures a comparison and lead-generation website around an immediate quote request. Visitors can submit their situation, learn how a home clearance works, browse city-specific information and review practical FAQs before being connected with relevant service providers.
items.excerpt: Home-clearance comparison site pairing an immediate quote request with city pages, FAQs and practical information for visitors who want more context.

items.title: Solardaktechnique
items.content: Solar Daktechnique presents a technical energy-services business through a clear WordPress journey around solar panels, charging solutions and related electrical work. Service information, trust content and quote or contact actions stay visible while technical detail remains secondary to the main service routes.
items.excerpt: Solar Daktechnique separates energy-service choices from supporting technical detail before quotation or contact.

items.title: Neturalhome
items.content: Netural Home uses sanitary products, floors, tiles and renovation projects as the inspiration layer, then connects them to showroom advice. Brand information and tailored advice support the move from browsing to an appointment or quotation.
items.excerpt: Interior and renovation site moving from sanitary, flooring and tile inspiration through project examples to showroom advice and quote access.

items.title: Oxfordacademy
items.content: Tutoring, homework guidance, exam preparation, remedial support and school services form Oxford Academy's education offering. Locations, a six-step approach, teacher profiles, reviews and signup or trial-lesson options support those services within the same site.
items.excerpt: Oxford Academy brings tutoring, homework support, exam preparation and school services together with reviews and signup routes.

items.title: Marcosmontage
items.content: Marcos Montage is presented through a practical service hierarchy for installation work. Responsive pages keep the technical offer understandable and place quote or contact access close to each service regardless of screen size.
items.excerpt: Marcos Montage explains installation support through concise service information, with quotation access close to the relevant service.

items.title: Hasene
items.content: Hasene's nonprofit site is anchored in humanitarian projects, donation choices and participation information. The WordPress structure helps visitors move from learning about a cause to understanding how a specific donation or participation process works.
items.excerpt: Humanitarian project pages, donation paths, FAQs and related updates guide visitors from learning about a cause to a concrete way to participate.

items.title: Homeplaza
items.content: Home Plaza spans kitchens, bathrooms, floors, wall finishes, steel doors, custom cabinetry, stair renovation and complete home renovation. Showroom information and a visible project process connect those categories to appointments and quote requests.
items.excerpt: Renovation and interior site organized around service categories, showroom proof, project steps and appointment or quote actions.

items.title: Brightlyn
items.content: Brightlyn supports a cybersecurity and regulatory consultancy whose services span risk, resilience, DORA, NIS2 and assurance. Complex advisory content is arranged around sectors, a clear end-to-end approach and direct consultation options.
items.excerpt: Cybersecurity consultancy WordPress website connecting complex regulatory services, sector focus and a clear end-to-end advisory approach.
